spotlights.title: Thank you for coming to Howloween!
spotlights.content: This year's Howloween saw over 650 attendeees! We are grateful for everyone who came and hope you enjoyed the event. If you would like to help us plan for an even better Howloween next year, your feedback would be greatly appreciated :3

spotlights.title: Want to stay updated?
spotlights.content: If you want to stay updated on news related to the event, you should join our Discord server or Telegram announcement channel :3

spotlights.title: What is Howloween?
spotlights.content:
Howloween is an annual Halloween-themed mini convention at UC San Diego, hosted by Triton Tails, UCSD's resident furry club. Attendees can enjoy a wide range of activities, from vendor fairs and gaming to costume and dance competitions, night raves, and more!

 Howloween started in 2024 with just an artist alley and a couple of rooms. Since then, it has grown into a much larger event, bringing in many different student orgs on campus for collaboration and hundreds of attendees each year.
